metadata.note: Statewide offices as SEATS. A seat is the office, with a stable id; ga-executive.json holds the PEOPLE and each official's `officeId` points here. Facts about the office (presidesOver) live on the seat, so they do not have to be copied to the next holder; ga-executive.html reads presidesOver from here. `holders` is newest first. History is NOT backfilled: no source of prior holders has been chosen or reviewed, so every `start` is null and a null is not a claim. History is recorded forward from the January 2027 turnover: on 2026-11-20 the outgoing holders' `end` / `endedBy` were staged from the unofficial 2026 general results (each with `endBasis`, `note` and `source`). The incoming winners are staged as `provisional: true` holders (newest first, so holders[0]); their execIds are reserved here and the people join ga-executive.json at the swearing-in. The current holder is the first holder that is not provisional. Hand-maintained; see docs/seat-history-design.md.
